title: Meet the customer in her hands
action: Open on the beautiful Samoyed’s whole face: upright ears, a goofy natural grin. The groomer is already washing him with both hands.
audio: Water and gentle room tone. The phone begins to ring.
graphics: Tiny AI Receptionist brand mark. No large overlay.

title: Both hands. One very good dog.
action: The Samoyed tilts his head as her soapy hands work through his coat. Stay in the present. She has not stopped grooming.
audio: NARRATOR: “It always rings when your hands are full.”
graphics: Natural little dog movement, no cartoon sound effects.

title: She hears it. She can’t pick up.
action: She glances at the ringing phone on the dry counter. Both hands stay wet and occupied with the dog; she returns her attention to him.
audio: NARRATOR: “And there’s someone on the other end who needs you, too.”
graphics: Small incoming-call glass pill. No attempted reach for the phone.

title: Milo could use a little help
action: Hold on Milo’s exact wild-haired face. His customer says the haircut line from off-screen.
audio:
CUSTOMER, affectionately to Milo: “We’re getting you a haircut.”
A short ringback.
graphics: Let the real-looking dog supply the humor; no gag text.

title: A reassuring answer
action: The open-eyed mascot answers beside the studio scene. The groomer stays quiet and keeps washing; the AI is speaking to the caller.
audio: AI: “Hi, Happy Paws Grooming. How can I help?”
graphics: “AI Receptionist” remains visible on the small glass overlay. Happy Paws Grooming is a fictional demo name.

title: A specific request
action: Cut to the same caller, speaking naturally. Milo stays off-screen rather than changing appearance.
audio: CUSTOMER: “Could I book Milo for his usual groom on Thursday? After lunch would be ideal.”
graphics: One short caption at a time. Returning-customer example; details established off-screen.

title: An answer that fits
action: The AI presents a suitable available afternoon slot. Keep the owner visible in the background; this happens alongside her work.
audio: AI: “There’s a two o’clock appointment available on Thursday. Would you like that one?”
graphics: Highlight “Thursday · 2 PM”; do not make the caller navigate the interface.

title: The customer chooses
action: The same caller smiles as she accepts the offered appointment.
graphics: The selected time settles gently into place. No narrator over dialogue.

title: Both customers taken care of
action: The owner dries the dog. Beside her, the new appointment resolves into a confirmation. The two threads meet.
audio: AI: “You’re all set. Milo is booked for Thursday at two. See you then.”
graphics: Booking card, drawn check, three brief celebration strokes. Quiet confirmation tone.

title: The work is finished
action: The appointment has finished. She puts away her apron, ready to leave. This is the first time her hands are free.
audio: NARRATOR: “The appointment’s booked. One less call to return before you head out.”
graphics: A quiet, settled booking confirmation. No new person, business or location.

title: Time for her plans
action: Work finished, the groomer heads outside with her hiking bag.
audio:
NARRATOR: “Because you have plans, too.”
OWNER, voice message: “On my way.”
graphics: Door closes; music opens up. The bag appears here for the first time.

title: A life beyond the next ring
action: The groomer meets her partner by the lake after work. She is present with her partner, phone put away. Let this shot breathe, then add the invitation.
audio: NARRATOR: “Be there for your customers. And for yourself. Meet your AI receptionist.”
graphics: “Take your day back.” → “Meet your AI receptionist.” Small connected-pilot note.
